name: Red Sea & Nile
about: Oct–Apr is warm, dry and comfortable for sightseeing and diving; Jun–Aug is punishingly hot, especially inland.
overview: Ancient temples and pyramids along the Nile, paired with Red Sea diving and beach resorts.
costOverview: Food and local transport are some of the cheapest in the region — Nile cruises and guided touring are where real money goes.
